_provenance: Illustrative, for the fictional Country X: reported actions (mitigation measures and adaptation actions) copied from one pilot country's Biennial Transparency Report, with places, agencies, programmes and companies replaced by generic terms (python/scripts/build_countryx_layers.py). sourceRef.section: Action Plan of the Nationally Determined Contribution

groupingLabel: Adaptation goal of the NDC action plan

adaptationGoals.description: Reduce impact and risk of climate change in the livestock sector, ensure sustainable development in the sectoral development and increase production

Establish a sustainable supply chain mechanism of healthy food products, livestock fodder and raw materials for light industry through leveraging positive impacts and mitigation of negative impacts of climate change in agricultural sector
Introducing optimal water consumption and build capacity to increase water reserves
Create forest ecosystems well adapted to climate change and enhance carbon sequestration by implementing sustainable forest management
Enable adaptation opportunities and adaptive capacities for vulnerable biodiversity to climate change
Build resilience to natural disasters by reducing the risks and adapting to impacts of climate and weather-related hazards and disasters

Strengthening healthcare services and capacities for early warning of potential health risks, and provision of proactive and response measures through the comprehensive study of climate impacts on public health

Establish a system providing social safeguard, insurance and prevention measures to reduce the vulnerability of social groups and build their resilience to climate change impacts by identifying groups vulnerable to climate change
